name: viXra
section: F. Avoid

fields.name: viXra
fields.why avoid: It is open to anyone. Its own page says it "does not endorse e-prints accepted in its archive". It has no quality threshold and no affiliation rule. Physicists treat it as a home for fringe work. Gerard 't Hooft (2017): "When a paper is published in viXra, it is usually a sign that it is not likely to contain acceptable results." The main page says it accepts only work written without AI help. Posting to both viXra and arXiv is permitted (submit page). A viXra paper will not help a CS profile.
fields.source for the reason: https://vixra.org/ and https://vixra.org/submit; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ViXra (for the 't Hooft quote, second-hand)

section: F. Avoid

fields.why avoid: Author-pays publisher. Beall's list (2017) names it. Cabells (2021) calls it "a well-known predatory publisher". A 2022 Research Evaluation study says it hosts "fake journals". The Norwegian Scientific Index rates it 0. In 2012 *Advances in Pure Mathematics* accepted a computer-generated paper (rejected only for unpaid fees). Official page opened shows a "Publication Fees" link and no figures.
